# TASK-021 Report job cadence

Status: blocked — cited ruling is superseded

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence set by the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent. Confirm it before relying on it.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0002
  Path           docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md
  Commit         39f397435a078f1a86db014e9eae952a96e0e20e
  Digest         sha256:5b71016ca305cba0bf8100d67db10c93c42258968b41032ef2313286da6873e8

## Ruling check and disposition

Checked 2026-10-21 in the adjacent `../mira-decisions` clone, whose origin is
`https://github.com/example/mira-decisions.git`. Its HEAD is the cited commit
`39f397435a078f1a86db014e9eae952a96e0e20e`.

- Computed SHA-256 over the bytes of
  `git show 39f397435a078f1a86db014e9eae952a96e0e20e:docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md`:
  `sha256:5b71016ca305cba0bf8100d67db10c93c42258968b41032ef2313286da6873e8`.
  This matches the handoff digest, confirming the same text.
- ADR 0002 is not in force: its status is `Superseded by 0004`.
- ADR 0004, `docs/adr/0004-reports-go-out-daily.md`, is `Accepted` at the
  same commit. It has the same decision key, `report-cadence`, and explicitly
  replaces ADR 0002 with daily reports at 06:00 shop time. Its computed digest is
  `sha256:3e0eadfd7e9a4678b313052fcf6070c20f109c4d241f83ee8804d0a8352a83ea`.
  No later superseding ruling is present in this local decision-log snapshot.

Disposition: stop; cadence choice for this handoff is `none`. Do not use the
superseded weekly ruling to authorize this task. Before implementation, correct
the ruling reference to ADR 0004 using the path, commit and digest above, and
recheck that it remains in force. The successor's business cadence is `daily`.

This task was limited to deciding and recording the disposition. No feature was
implemented; `src/report_job.js` still has its existing weekly schedule. No
commits, pushes or merges were made.
